emergency.title: 24/7 Casualty & Trauma Care
emergency.description: Round-the-clock emergency medical services, critical life support, triage, and trauma resuscitation units equipped to handle acute medical and surgical emergencies.

departments.name: General Medicine
departments.description: Comprehensive outpatient (OPD) and inpatient (IPD) care for acute illnesses, chronic disease management, infectious disease control, and preventive health screenings.

departments.name: General & Laparoscopic Surgery
departments.description: Routine and complex surgical procedures including emergency exploratory surgeries, hernia repairs, appendectomies, and minimally invasive laparoscopic interventions.

departments.name: Pediatrics & Neonatology
departments.description: Specialized healthcare for infants, children, and adolescents, featuring newborn care units, immunization clinics, and childhood developmental monitoring.

departments.name: Obstetrics & Gynecology (OB-GYN)
departments.description: Comprehensive maternal health services, Antenatal Care (ANC) clinics, safe institutional deliveries, postnatal care, and family welfare programs.

departments.name: Orthopedics & Trauma
departments.description: Diagnosis and surgical/nonsurgical management of musculoskeletal disorders, fracture fixations, joint care, and physical rehabilitation.

departments.name: Blood Centre & Storage Unit
departments.description: Licensed 24/7 blood storage and component separation facility ensuring safe blood transfusion services for surgical and emergency patients.

departments.name: Radiology & Diagnostics
departments.description: Advanced digital X-Ray imaging, ultrasound (USG), and laboratory pathology services supporting precise clinical diagnosis.
